sources.label: Zdrgon's Morphe Patches including Direct-to-Cell Satellite Data Optimization
sources.author: Zdrgon
patch_list: Spoofs the installer source so the app appears to be installed from Google Play. Required for Smart MP3 Tagger: its PairIP local installer check is live, so a re-signed build fails the license check without it — keep it on.
Turns on the app's Pro state (no ads, unlimited functions) as if the one-time "Super Pro Forever" purchase were owned — the lifetime state, with nothing to expire.
